children: GULF RESOURCES, INC. reported first-quarter 2026 results with revenue up materially year over year but a net loss narrowed versus the prior-year quarter. Net revenue rose to $2.37M while the company posted a net loss of $3.93M, and diluted loss per share improved to $2.48.
Revenue was $2.37M for Q1 2026, compared with $1.60M in Q1 2025; YoY change 48%.
Net income (loss) was a loss of $3.93M for Q1 2026, compared with a loss of $4.63M in Q1 2025; loss narrowed ~15% YoY.
Diluted EPS was a loss of $2.48 in Q1 2026, compared with a loss of $3.90 in Q1 2025.
Revenue growth was driven primarily by higher bromine sales and improved bromine prices; bromine comprised about 95% of sales for the quarter.
Bromine production resumed across key factories, with tonnes sold up 13% and plant utilization rising about 5 percentage points.
Chemical and natural gas segments were non-revenue or divested during the period, reflecting a narrowed product mix concentrated on bromine.
Multiple plants received government approvals to resume production; company completed flood-prevention and relocation projects to support operations.
Operating cash flow turned positive in Q1 driven by improved collections and loan repayments, materially boosting liquidity to support ongoing operations.
